## Closed beta release

**Version:** 0.2.0-beta.1

### What's included
- Device Owner peel mode with cloud companion control (HTTPS)
- Per-device pairing — create a device in the companion browser
- Blocked URLs (Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet)
- Hard-block feed apps (YouTube, Instagram, etc.) when peeled
- Delayed unpeel timer
- In-app + companion setup guides

### Tester package
1. Install from **Google Play closed testing** (primary) or download **`onionpeel-0.2.0-beta.1.apk`** below (fallback)
2. Read **[BETA.md](https://github.com/bropunzal/onionpeel/blob/main/BETA.md)** — factory reset required
3. Open the **cloud companion URL** → Create new device → copy Server URL + token

### Cloud companion
See **[CLOUD.md](https://github.com/bropunzal/onionpeel/blob/main/CLOUD.md)** for deploy instructions.
